description: Single-panel data table (no micrographs or plots). "Table 4. Alternative set of elastic parameters" is rendered as a table with a grey-shaded header row carrying a "Compound" column followed by five parameter columns — B0 (bulk modulus, GPa), Cα (factor of anisotropy, dimensionless), G (shear modulus, GPa), E100 and E111 (Young's modulus along [100] and [111], GPa) — each of which is split into two numeric sub-columns. Six compound rows are listed. FeAl: B0 = 164 and −179; Cα = 0.54 and −0.53; G = 81.5 and −85.5; E100 = 210 and −221; E111 = 333 and −370. Fe3Al: 153/−171; 0.12/0.08; 21/−9.5; 60/−28; 322/−270. Fe3AlC(sp): 216/−206; 2.39/−2.47; 175/−168.5; 477/−397; 217/−227. Fe2AlC, FeMnAlC and Mn3AlC have em-dashes in the left sub-column of every parameter (e.g. FeMnAlC −/−201; −/−1.94; −/−195; −/−446; −/−263; Mn3AlC −/−214; −/−1.59; −/−175; −/−412; −/−285). Fe3AlC(sp) shows the largest B0, G, E100 and Cα, whereas FeAl shows the largest E111 (333 GPa). The table demonstrates that the calculated elastic anisotropy differs markedly across the Fe-Al and Fe-Al-C phases.

subfigures.description: A single rendered data table of calculated elastic parameters for six compounds (FeAl, Fe3Al, Fe3AlC(sp), Fe2AlC, FeMnAlC, Mn3AlC). Header: Compound, B0, Cα, G, E100, E111; each parameter occupies two numeric sub-columns. The last three rows have em-dashes in the left sub-column.

observations.observation: Fe3AlC(sp) has the largest bulk modulus (216 and −206) and the largest shear modulus (175 and −168.5) of all six compounds.
Fe3AlC(sp) also has the largest Cα values, 2.39 and −2.47, the highest anisotropy factor in the table.
Fe3AlC(sp) has the largest E100 (477 and −397) but a comparatively low E111 (217 and −227), lower than FeAl (333) and Fe3Al (322).
Fe3Al shows the smallest shear-modulus values (21 and −9.5) of the rows that are fully populated.
The rows Fe2AlC, FeMnAlC and Mn3AlC contain em-dashes in the left sub-column of every parameter, so only the right-hand sub-column values are reported for these three compounds.
The caption states that B0, G, E100 and E111 are in GPa and Cα is the factor of anisotropy.
The citing text states these practical elastic parameters (B0, Cα, G and E along [100] and [111]) were calculated from the calculated set of elastic constants and listed in Table 4.
The table is titled 'Alternative set of elastic parameters', and the meaning/nature of the two numeric sub-columns per parameter is not stated in the caption or in the visible header.

unreadable_items: Meaning/origin of the two numeric sub-columns per parameter (e.g. whether they are two calculation methods or two signs) is not indicated in the header, caption or citing text.
